race.comment: CHANTRA (9) faded last time to finish fourth over 1200m at Warrnambool after showing good early speed. Good winner the start prior, should be prominent early and nearing peak fitness now. KAKKOII (3) is a once-promising stayer back from a break of seven months. Raced below par at his only appearance last prep when fifth over 1400m at Pakenham but is better than that and deserves another chance here. ANTALIAN (4) started this preparation with a win two runs ago. Less impressive last time out when eighth over 1300m at Geelong, beaten 3.5 lengths. Nicely placed to return to winning form. STRONG TEMPO (11) couldn't have been more impressive only debut and while up in grade here, looks suited up to 1400m and should be better for the debut experience.
